example.title: When the profile exceeds its deadline

narrative: TableProfile reports `status.state`. While planning, inspect the request’s source, mode, and budget. During aggregation, follow the profile workflow. A successful request publishes `status.result`. For a failed or cancelled profile, inspect `status.failure`, `status.accounting`, and `status.cleanupComplete`. During a nonterminal partition retry, `status.execution.partitionBackoff` reports RUNTIME_OVERLOADED, the affected partition count and retryAt when known. It clears once no partitions are waiting. Cleanup can finish after the request reaches its terminal state.
